IN NO EVENT SHALL THE COPYRIGHT OWNER OR CONTRIBUTORS BE LIABLE FOR * ANY DIRECT, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES * (INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO, PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES; * LOSS OF USE, DATA, OR PROFITS; OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION) HOWEVER CAUSED AND * ON ANY THEORY OF LIABILITY, WHETHER IN CONTRACT, STRICT LIABILITY, OR TORT * (INCLUDING NEGLIGENCE OR OTHERWISE) ARISING IN ANY WAY OUT OF THE USE OF THIS * SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE. */ package com.quetzalcharges; /** * What the next recharge would do with a particular meat. *

* Pitri walks the inventory in slot order and takes meat until the whistle is full. He does not * pick the meat that fits -- he takes whatever comes next -- so a meat worth more charges than the * whistle still needs is consumed anyway and the remainder is lost. Which meat that turns out to be * depends entirely on where it sits in the inventory, which is why this is a per-slot verdict rather * than a per-item one. */ enum MeatUse { /** Taken, and every charge it carries fits in the whistle. */ USED, /** Taken, but it carries more charges than the whistle still needs and the surplus is lost. */ WASTEFUL, /** The whistle is already full by the time Pitri reaches this slot, so it is left alone. */ UNUSED }
